lines.text: In the late 1960s, a killer in California mailed letters to the newspapers... daring the police to catch him. They never did.
Northern California. December 1968. A young couple is shot on a quiet road outside Vallejo.
Six months later, another couple is attacked at a parking lot called Blue Rock Springs.
Then the letters arrive. He calls himself the Zodiac. He sends coded messages and dares anyone to crack them.
September 1969. Lake Berryessa. Two people are attacked by a man in a black hood. Only one survives.
October 1969. San Francisco. A cab driver is shot in the Presidio Heights neighborhood. The killer walks away into the night.
Police confirmed five killed. In his letters, he claimed thirty seven.
For decades, detectives chased suspect after suspect. No one was ever charged.
In 2020, three amateur codebreakers finally cracked one of his ciphers. Fifty one years later. It still didn't give his name.
The case is still open. Comment case still open... and sleep tight, partner.
